topics: Introduction to Software Architecture:  Definition and Importance
Role of the Architect vs. Engineer
Requirements engineering: Stakeholders, Concerns, and Types of Requirements
Architectural Patterns and Styles:   Architectural Patterns- Overview of Patterns and Styles
Applying Patterns and Choosing a Style
Patterns for Enterprise Applications: Enterprise Applications and Layered Patterns
Components, Contracts, and Service-Oriented Architectures:  Component Software- Nature of Components and Reuse
Design by Contract- Contracts, Polymorphism, Inheritance, and Delegation
Service-Oriented Architectures- Standards, Technologies, and Security
Architecture Evaluation and Description:  Describing Architectures and Viewpoints
Architectural Description Languages (ADLs)- Overview and Applications

partB.description:
● Each question carries 9 marks.  
● Two questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered.  
● Each question can have a maximum of 3 subdivisions.

courseOutcomes.description: Understand the foundational concepts of software architecture, including the roles of stakeholders and the importance of requirements engineering.
Apply architectural patterns and styles to design software systems, particularly in enterprise contexts.
Understand the principles of component-based software design and the use of contracts in ensuring reliable software systems.
Apply architectural description techniques to document and evaluate software architectures.
